game.likely.title: Most Likely
game.likely.howto.1: A card appears: "Who's most likely to…"
game.likely.howto.2: Vote on your phone for the person who fits best. Yes, you can vote for yourself.
game.likely.howto.3: Reveal! See who got picked, and by whom.
game.likely.howto.3.anon: Reveal! See the percentages. Who voted for whom stays secret.
game.likely.howto.4: Agree with the others to score, and collect your award at the end.
game.likely.howto.4.anon: Collect your award at the end. Secret votes: no points tonight.
game.likely.rules.vote.title: Vote
game.likely.rules.vote.body: One vote per card, for any player, yourself included. You can change it until time's up.
game.likely.rules.points.title: Points
game.likely.rules.points.body: +50 for each other player who picked the same person as you (up to +300 a card). Everyone agreed? +400 each. Voted for yourself and at least 2 others did too? +100 more. Secret votes: no points, only awards.
game.likely.rules.chaos.title: Chaos
game.likely.rules.chaos.body: If everyone votes for someone different, nobody wins the card.
game.likely.rules.awards.title: Awards
game.likely.rules.awards.body: Each card has an award. At the end, everyone gets their signature award. The most points wins the Mind Reader award.
game.likely.rules.secret.title: Secret votes
game.likely.rules.secret.body: If the host turned off "Show who voted", the TV shows only percentages, never who voted for whom, and nobody scores points. With only a few players, people can still guess.
game.likely.rules.spicy.title: Spicy mode (18+)
game.likely.rules.spicy.body: Only for adults, switched on from the TV. Some cards name a player; that player can't be voted for on that card. The host can skip any card.
game.likely.coach.card: Read the card on the TV. Who comes to mind?
game.likely.coach.voting: Tap the person who fits best. Nobody sees your pick yet.
game.likely.coach.reveal: Eyes on the TV: who did the room pick?
game.likely.coach.awards: Everyone leaves with an award. Everyone.
game.likely.coach.hold: We need 3 players to keep going.
game.likely.pause.endGame.confirm: End the game and go straight to the awards?
game.likely.setup.spicyFromTv: Turn it on from the TV
game.likely.spicy.gate.title: Spicy mode is for adults only
game.likely.spicy.gate.body: Cards can be suggestive and can name players. Everyone playing tonight must be 18 or older.
game.likely.card.question: Who's most likely to {prompt}?
game.likely.vote.title: Tap a player
game.likely.vote.locked: Vote in! You can still change it.
game.likely.vote.waitingNext: You're in! You'll vote from the next card.
game.likely.vote.named: This card is about {name}: pick someone else
game.likely.reveal.chaos: Total chaos! You don't agree on anything.
game.likely.reveal.tie: It's a tie! Everyone takes the award.
game.likely.awards.title: Awards Night
game.likely.awards.mystery: The Mystery Award: nobody could pin you down.
game.likely.awards.mystery.title: The Mystery Award
game.likely.awards.mystery.line: A whole game, and still no file on you.
game.likely.awards.star.title: Tonight's Star
game.likely.awards.star.line: Tonight's script only had one name in it.
game.likely.awards.selfAware.title: The Self-Aware Award
game.likely.awards.selfAware.line: You pleaded guilty before anyone could accuse you.
game.likely.awards.mindReader.title: The Mind Reader Award
game.likely.awards.mindReader.line: You read this room like an open book.
game.likely.results.title: And the awards go to…
game.likely.error.staleCard: That card is gone. Vote on the new one!
